Cookie Policy

Last updated: 2026-10-03

Status

DRAFT FOR LEGAL REVIEW: replace bracketed placeholders and have a qualified lawyer review this page before launch.

Cookies

This site does not set analytics, advertising or other non-essential cookies. Our hosting provider may use strictly necessary cookies or similar technologies for security, such as bot protection. [Confirm against your Cloudflare configuration before launch.]

Local storage

We save your theme preference (key: theme) in localStorage. You can clear it in your browser settings at any time.

What cookies are

Cookies are small text files that a website asks your browser to store. They are commonly used for logins, preferences, analytics and advertising. Other browser storage, such as localStorage, works in a similar way but is not sent automatically with every request.

What this site stores

The site stores one preference: your chosen light or dark theme, under the key “theme”, in localStorage. It stays on your device and is read by the page to apply your choice. The site does not set analytics or advertising cookies and does not use social media tracking buttons.

Hosting and security

Our hosting provider may use technical mechanisms for security, performance or abuse prevention. These can involve cookies or similar technologies depending on configuration. [The operator must confirm the actual Cloudflare settings and update this section before launch.]

How to control storage

You can clear localStorage and cookies in your browser’s privacy settings, and you can browse in a private window so that the theme preference is not retained. Clearing the preference only resets the theme to your system default.

If this changes

If analytics or other non-essential cookies are added, we will describe them here, say what they do and how long they last, and provide a way to consent or refuse where the law requires it.

Why we avoid tracking cookies

The tool does not need accounts or personalisation, so there is no reason to track visitors across pages or sites. That keeps the experience simple and avoids the consent banners that non-essential cookies normally require.

Details of the theme preference

The preference is a single short word, “light” or “dark”, saved only after you press the theme button. If you never press it, nothing is saved and the site follows your device setting. It is not shared with us or with third parties.

Browser extensions and tools

Extensions you install in your browser may add their own cookies or storage while you browse. Those are outside our control.

Contacting us about cookies

If you have a question about cookies or storage on this website, email compressimageto@gmail.com and include the page you were viewing and your browser. We will check the behaviour and update this policy if it is incomplete.

Future analytics

If we introduce privacy-friendly analytics, we will list the exact events measured, such as which tool page is opened or whether compression succeeded. We will not record image content, file names or image metadata. The cookie and privacy policies will be updated before such a change goes live.

Updates

The date at the top of this page shows when it was last changed. Please check back occasionally for changes.

Summary

In short: the site sets no analytics or advertising cookies, stores only your theme choice in your browser, and processes your images locally. Hosting and security systems that deliver the website may use technical mechanisms of their own, and the operator must confirm those before launch. You can clear the stored theme at any time in your browser settings, and you can contact us if anything here looks incorrect or incomplete for your situation.
